title: StarkDeFi (Starknet) — abandoned Cairo-1 AMM: live pre-fix skim bug on 96/312 pairs, $0 economically extractable
closed_reasons: buggy skim is live on 96 pairs but token1 assets are meme/dust (nominal $114.59 total, SPIST $62.09 of it)
full-drain donation d = r1 + b1 - b0 is in raw token0 units: ≈$100k-$36M+ (priced cases; 3 pairs unpriced token0) for every pair with nominally meaningful token1 (SPIST), steal <= $43 nominal
capital-feasible drains (JEDI-P nested meme LPs, donation 1.9-90.5 STRK returned) are worth ~$0
swap-then-skim variant best case $4.30 nominal for $67 capital -> negative after slippage (SPIST exit liquidity ~$40-80 total)
fixed classes (192+22+2 pairs, $71.6k of TVL) behaviorally proven correct skim (309-pair probe)
fee vaults pair/handler-gated; router has no arbitrary-call path; no pair self-LP balances; upgrades/pause/fees fee_handler-gated

pair classes: 0x30ca5759 (192, fixed), 0x4a56a2e3 (22, fixed), 0x63c46cdc (2, fixed), 0xaef408ec (96, BUGGY pre-fix skim; also factory's current pair class)

fee vaults (312, class 0x288f1781...): $14,730.64 accumulated fees; claim_lp_fees pair-only, claim_protocol_fees fee_handler-or-pair (~70% H-O LP / ~30% P protocol)
SPIST: 359,930,678 held by 10 buggy pairs, implied price $1.725e-7 (median of 5 JediSwap pools), total SPIST pool depth ~$40-80
fee_handler = ArgentX account 0x61dac032 class holding 58.22 STRK (nonce 291); fee_to = Braavos account holding 168.09 STRK (nonce 277) -> privileged upgrade risk live, not E-U
caveats: prices are spot DefiLlama/implied-pool values at stated blocks; token valuations approximate
LP holder distribution not enumerable without events; H-O assumes live holders (dead holders would move value to S)
vault 70/30 LP/protocol split is by design; exact claimability depends on live claims
fee_handler/fee_to liveness inferred from funded balances/nonces, not tx history
stable-curve rounding of fixed classes not exhaustively fuzzed (residual low uncertainty; k-check + fees make extraction implausible)
one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract ~$0 live: the pre-fix skim bug is real and proven on 96 StarkDeFi pairs (incl. the factory's current class) but all reachable token1 value is meme/dust or requires ≈$100k-$36M+ capital to steal <=$43 nominal, while the $71.9k TVL sits in fixed-class pairs as LP-owned value (H-O).
